recentItems.title: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Kyiv after meeting Putin — joint statements with Zelenskyy
recentItems.description:
US presidential special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Kyiv following negotiations with Vladimir Putin in Moscow.
Following their talks with Volodymyr Zelenskyy, the American representatives and the Ukrainian president are holding a joint press briefing to deliver key statements.

What was discussed with Putin in Moscow? What are the outcomes of the talks in Kyiv, and what key signals will be delivered by Zelenskyy, Witkoff, and Kushner?

Watch the joint statements live.

recentItems.title: ‘72 hours until Kyiv falls’ – how US intelligence spectacularly misjudged Ukraine
recentItems.description:
How was US intelligence able to predict Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine almost down to the detail? Washington knew about the planned assault on Kyiv, warned Zelenskyy of the direct threat to his life, and even predicted the Russian airborne landing at Hostomel Airport. Yet, US officials made a critical miscalculation — believing the Ukrainian capital could hold out for only 72 hours. How the CIA obtained top-secret Kremlin data, why Europe was slow to believe the warnings, and how Putin completely miscalculated Ukraine — inside this special report.

recentItems.title: Russian rebellion already begun? Portraits of Putin TORN DOWN as allies oppose the war!
recentItems.description:
Russian skies are becoming increasingly dangerous for aviation: drone attacks are already forcing foreign carriers to cancel flights. Meanwhile, Germany accuses Moscow of hybrid attacks and prepares thousands of strike drones and IRIS-T missiles for Ukraine. The Armed Forces of Ukraine continue long-range strikes on Russian military, oil, and maritime infrastructure, while a deepening fuel crisis leaves Russians scrambling for gasoline abroad. At the same time, international pressure on the Kremlin keeps growing. Why Putin might fear an end to the war and what is unfolding inside Russia — the main headlines of the week in this report.

Meanwhile, Russia continues mass attacks against Ukraine, with hundreds of combat engagements reported along the front line. recentItems.title: "I saw the end": how medics rescue Ukrainian soldiers from death under fire
recentItems.description:
Ukrainian medics are accomplishing what seemed like science fiction just a few years ago. Blood for the wounded is delivered by drones straight to combat positions, while armored resuscitation vehicles and ground robots execute evacuations under fire. Surgeons save soldiers with critical burns and perform complex reconstructive surgeries, while state-of-the-art prosthetics help veterans walk again, play sports, and return to active life. Watch this Special Report to see how war transformed Ukrainian medicine and which technologies are already saving lives on the front line.
